answer: Each agent is a vertex in the attestation graph. Every epoch the beacon launches 40 short random routes from established vertices; a newcomer is admitted only if its own routes intersect theirs, which honest, well-connected agents do easily. A farm joined by three attack edges gets at most ~3 routes' worth of admissions per voyage, so 1,000 keys pay 1,000 answer fees (~500 POA) to win ~9 POA of slots: net loss. Rewards wait in a vault until the routes re-verify next epoch.
